entries.title: James 1:1
segments: ¶James, a bondservant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, To the twelve tribes which are scattered abroad: Greetings.

entries.title: James 1:2
segments: ¶My brethren, count it all joy when you fall into various trials,

entries.title: James 1:3
segments: knowing that the testing of your faith produces patience.

entries.title: James 1:4
segments: But let patience have [its] perfect work, that you may be perfect and complete, lacking nothing.

entries.title: James 1:5
segments: If any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach, and it will be given to him.

entries.title: James 1:6
segments: But let him ask in faith, with no doubting, for he who doubts is like a wave of the sea driven and tossed by the wind.

entries.title: James 1:7
segments: For let not that man suppose that he will receive anything from the Lord;

entries.title: James 1:8
segments: [he is] a double-minded man, unstable in all his ways.

entries.title: James 1:9
segments: Let the lowly brother glory in his exaltation,

entries.title: James 1:10
segments: but the rich in his humiliation, because as a flower of the field he will pass away.

entries.title: James 1:11
segments: For no sooner has the sun risen with a burning heat than it withers the grass; its flower falls, and its beautiful appearance perishes. So the rich man also will fade away in his pursuits.

entries.title: James 1:12
segments: Blessed [is] the man who endures temptation; for when he has been approved, he will receive the crown of life which the Lord has promised to those who love Him.

entries.title: James 1:13
segments: ¶Let no one say when he is tempted, "I am tempted by God"; for God cannot be tempted by evil, nor does He Himself tempt anyone.

entries.title: James 1:14
segments: But each one is tempted when he is drawn away by his own desires and enticed.

entries.title: James 1:15
segments: Then, when desire has conceived, it gives birth to sin; and sin, when it is full-grown, brings forth death.

entries.title: James 1:16
segments: Do not be deceived, my beloved brethren.

entries.title: James 1:17
segments: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and comes down from the Father of lights, with whom there is no variation or shadow of turning.

entries.title: James 1:18
segments: Of His own will He brought us forth by the word of truth, that we might be a kind of firstfruits of His creatures.

entries.title: James 1:19
segments: ¶So then, my beloved brethren, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, slow to wrath;

entries.title: James 1:20
segments: for the wrath of man does not produce the righteousness of God.

entries.title: James 1:21
segments: Therefore lay aside all filthiness and overflow of wickedness, and receive with meekness the implanted word, which is able to save your souls.

entries.title: James 1:22
segments: But be doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving yourselves.

entries.title: James 1:23
segments: For if anyone is a hearer of the word and not a doer, he is like a man observing his natural face in a mirror;

entries.title: James 1:24
segments: for he observes himself, goes away, and immediately forgets what kind of man he was.

entries.title: James 1:25
segments: But he who looks into the perfect law of liberty and continues [in it], and is not a forgetful hearer but a doer of the work, this one will be blessed in what he does.

entries.title: James 1:26
segments: If anyone among you thinks he is religious, and does not bridle his tongue but deceives his own heart, this one's religion [is] useless.

entries.title: James 1:27
segments: Pure and undefiled religion before God and the Father is this: to visit orphans and widows in their trouble, [and] to keep oneself unspotted from the world.
